entities.name: URSP
entities.description: UE Route Selection Policy procedure requiring interaction between upper layers and 5GSM entities in the UE for PDU session management.

entities.name: Upper layers
entities.description: Protocol layers above 5GSM that interact with 5GSM entities for PDU session establishment and release.

entities.name: 5GSM entity
entities.description: 5G Session Management entity in the UE responsible for handling PDU sessions.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: Packet Data Unit session established between UE and network.

entities.name: PDU session attributes
entities.description: Attributes of a PDU session including PDU session identity, SSC mode, S-NSSAI, DNN, PDU session type, access type, and PDU address.

entities.name: Establish PDU session
entities.description: Procedure to establish a new PDU session with specified attributes.

entities.name: Release PDU session
entities.description: Procedure to release an existing PDU session.

relations.description: URSP procedure requires interaction with upper layers.
URSP procedure requires interaction with 5GSM entities.
5GSM entity indicates PDU session attributes to upper layers when session is established.
5GSM entity informs upper layers of released PDU session identity when session is released.
Upper layers can request 5GSM entity to establish a PDU session with specified attributes.
Upper layers can request 5GSM entity to release an existing PDU session.
PDU session establishment procedure includes specification of PDU session attributes.
PDU session release procedure terminates an existing PDU session.
